A '''timer bomb''' was a type of [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]]. An [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] once placed a timer bomb in the path of a [[U2-C1-series housekeeping droid]], which was then [[Vacuum cleaner|vacuumed]] up into the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] interior. The bomb then exploded outside the office of a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] executive as it passed by.<ref name="EGTD" />
